text: なげて　いいのは　ちきゅうなげ　だけ！

structure.jp: ちきゅうなげ　だけ！

patterns.name: 〜てもいい
patterns.explanation: て-form plus いい says it is okay to do. なげて　いい = 'you may throw'.

patterns.name: 〜の (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: の turns the phrase before it into 'the thing that'. なげて　いいのは = 'the thing it's okay to throw'.

patterns.name: 〜だけ
patterns.explanation: だけ means 'only'. ちきゅうなげ　だけ = 'only Seismic Toss'.
